lesson: Periodicity carried by a finite abelian group representation decomposes with the functional equation character by character, so it adds no inequality. The only extra datum is the cone, and the cone contains the Perron (zeta) direction unconstrained. A CROSS-1 candidate needs a non-commutative or non-decomposing carrier, or a step that reads "every coefficient matrix is a permutation matrix" together with the functional equation; E_a and T-NR pass everything else.
